design: Explanatory inference control added after observing that reward arms differ in generated response length during training, before inspecting their final retrieval or detail metrics. Does not affect promotion or checkpoint choice.
inputs: All 210 native first-caption validation images and the two views of the 16 locked detail images.
intervention: For each policy replay the first generation call with its native prompt, identical real pixels, and max_new_tokens=1. Read the last hidden state from this first decoding step (last input prompt position); no subsequent token or tool feedback. Use the same frozen downstream encoder. Compare against its own natural greedy trajectory. Verify bit-equality wherever natural decoding ended at this exact source position.
